mentions.name: Queryable climate data for major cities
mentions.description: This tool provides queryable climate data for major cities, helping users find locations that maximize the number of comfortable hours they can spend outdoors, whether doing light activity or just sitting around. A processed climate dataset can be queried directly by DeepSeek, and other AI agents can use the same interface.
mentions.problem: Finding where one can maximize the number of comfortable hours spent outdoors, whether doing light activity or just sitting around.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Queryable climate data for major cities. The main question I'm trying to answer is: where can I maximize the number of comfortable hours I can spend outdoors, whether doing light activity or just sitting around?
